content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@I, Set(Real))), Analysis.contOn(F, I), Logic.forall-typed(@x, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(x, I), Analysis.contAt(F, x))))

values.en: Continuity at every point of a given region `I`. This is pointwise continuity quantified over `I`, and is strictly weaker than uniform continuity on `I` — the `delta` is allowed to depend on the point.
values.zh-CN: 在给定区域 `I` 的每一点处连续。这是在 `I` 上量化的逐点连续性，并且严格弱于 `I` 上的一致连续性——`delta` 可以依赖于该点。
